2609.20124.title: Multi-Dimensional Prosody Judgment For Live Streaming Speech Synthesis
2609.20124.paper_summary: Evaluating live streaming speech synthesis (TTS) requires assessing fine-grained, highly expressive prosody such as emotion, intonation, and energy which traditional MOS predictors fail to capture. While proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) like Gemini can evaluate these aspects, they are too costly for massive inference and reinforcement learning feedback. To address this, we first introduce Live-ProsodyJudge (LPJ), a cost-effective pairwise evaluator distilled from Gemini into Qwen3-Omni. However, we identify a critical flaw in standard multi-dimensional evaluation: verdict coupling. The judge tends to lazily align all individual dimension scores with its overall preference, collapsing a rich multi-dimensional rubric into a single preference bit. To resolve this, we further propose Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge (D-LPJ). D-LPJ eliminates the overall verdict target to prevent blind following, masks uncertain pair-dimensions during Supervised Fine-Tuning(SFT), and introduces a novel span-local GRPO strategy that applies normalized advantages strictly to their corresponding rationale spans. Evaluated on highly curated human-annotated test sets, 10 sample balanced-order LPJ achieves higher point accuracy than a single Gemini call, while D-LPJ successfully produces independent,decoupled dimension judgments. Furthermore, in a Best-of-8 TTS candidate selection tournament, the LPJ-selected utterance falls within the human top-3 in 85.29% of high-confidence cases, demonstrating its efficacy for fine-grained TTS preference optimization.
2609.20124.paper_summary_zh: 評估即時串流語音合成（TTS）需要評估細緻且高度表達的韻律，例如情感、語調和能量，而傳統的MOS預測器無法捕捉這些方面。雖然像Gemini這樣的專有大型語言模型（LLMs）可以評估這些方面，但它們在大規模推理和強化學習反饋方面成本過高。為了解決這個問題，我們首先介紹了Live-ProsodyJudge（LPJ），這是一個從Gemini提煉至Qwen3-Omni的成本效益高的成對評估器。然而，我們識別出標準多維評估的一個關鍵缺陷：判決耦合。評審往往懶惰地將所有個別維度分數與其整體偏好對齊，將豐富的多維標準簡化為單一的偏好位元。為了解決這個問題，我們進一步提出了Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge（D-LPJ）。D-LPJ消除了整體判決目標，以防止盲目跟隨，在監督式微調（SFT）期間遮蔽不確定的成對維度，並引入了一種新穎的跨度局部GRPO策略，將正規化優勢嚴格應用於其相應的理由跨度。經過在高度策劃的人類標註測試集上的評估，10個樣本平衡順序的LPJ在準確度上超過了單一的Gemini調用，而D-LPJ成功地產生了獨立的、解耦的維度判斷。此外，在一個最佳8個TTS候選選拔賽中，LPJ選擇的發音在85.29%的高信心案例中落入人類前3名，顯示出其在細緻TTS偏好優化方面的有效性。
